name: The Apurva Kempinski Bali
positioning: Clifftop resort in Sawangan, Nusa Dua, with Balinese-inspired architecture and a personal concierge for every guest
best_for: Travelers who want Balinese culture shown in the architecture and in the experiences
Suite guests who want a private lounge with its own pools

facts.text: The Pendopo Lobby has towering Gebyok partitions, each crafted by local artisans.
The Cliff Lounge is reserved exclusively for suite guests.
The main swimming pool is set amid tropical gardens with views of the Indian Ocean, and a children's pool is next to it.
Guests can use Nissan Kicks Hybrid and Nissan Leaf Electric vehicles to explore the Nusa Dua area, booked through the concierge.
The resort is in Sawangan, Nusa Dua, set apart from Bali's busier tourist areas.
The Bali International Convention Center is listed as 5 km, about 10 minutes, from the resort.
The Apurva Spa bases its treatments on Javanese healing wisdoms.
Bai Yun is a dim sum and hot pot restaurant at the resort.

highlights.text: The Grand Staircase is inspired by Besakih, the island's mother temple, and is a signature detail of 250 flights of stairs.
Every guest is welcomed by a personal dedicated concierge called the Lady in Red, who gives personalised recommendations on what to see and do in Bali.
The cliff suites and waterfall hill took inspiration from subak, the Balinese irrigation system, reflecting Bali's terraced paddy fields.
The Cliff Lounge for suite guests is on the 9th and 10th floors of the cliff main building and has an infinity pool and a hydro jet pool.
The Spice Route Voyage takes guests aboard a handcrafted schooner phinisi through the waters of the Indonesian archipelago.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote clifftop location requires transportation to explore local attractions.
The Cliff Lounge and its pools are for suite guests only.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
